name: pointable-context
description: Fixture MCP probe plus an opt-in Codex Desktop companion for read-only local-workspace Quick Look.

interface.shortDescription: Fixture lookup and opt-in local workspace Quick Look.
interface.longDescription: Run the headless fixture-only MCP probe, or explicitly manage the experimental Codex Desktop local-workspace companion through its separate Skill. MCP results remain pinned to the bundled mini-project. The companion binds one host-visible Codex task to one user-approved local root and performs bounded read-only file lookup; it is not a DCPM/CWA Dashboard or a portable public host contract.
defaultPrompt: Run the Pointable Context fixture probe for GOV-1.
Resolve ARCH-7 inside the bundled mini-project without reading detail yet.
Show the fixture source, revision, and freshness for a returned entity reference.
Use the Pointable Context Workspace skill to bind this task to an explicit local workspace.
